enriched_activities.desc: Lies on bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Remains asleep. Turns to back. Remains asleep. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep. Turns to other side. Remains asleep. Stretches arm. Remains asleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to heat. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body and scrub. Rinse body. Apply shampoo to hair and scrub. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body and hair. Wrap towel around waist. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Wipe mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Place plate on counter. Open refrigerator again. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Open drawer. Take out knife. Spread butter on toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink milk. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Put on watch. Pick up bag. Check bag contents. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Turn off fan. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator at nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Greet colleague. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Attend morning meeting. Take notes. Discuss project. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Organize files. Update database. Write report. Eat lunch. Return to desk. Continue working. Attend afternoon meeting. Print documents. Review documents. Shut down computer. Pack bag. Leave office.
Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add salt. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Take plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Turn on light. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put remote down. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Continue watching TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Walk out of living room.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Browse internet. Check social media. Open document. Type notes. Close laptop. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Read book. Put book down. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Turn off desk lamp. Turn on fan. Lie on bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine (brushing teeth, washing face)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Pat dry with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Wipe mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading or winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Read book. Turn page. Read book. Put book down. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Turn off desk lamp. Adjust pillow. Lie down on bed. Close eyes.
Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Remain asleep. Turn to back. Remain asleep. Stretch arm. Remain asleep. Turn to other side. Remain asleep.
